title: Extremal degree-based indices of general polyomino chains via dynamic programming
summary: In this paper, we develop a dynamic programming framework for identifying extremal general polyomino chains with respect to degree-based topological indices. As a concrete application, we resolve an open problem posed in 2015 by determining, for any given number of squares, the general polyomino chains that maximize the generalized Randić index with parameter $α=-1$. We show that the extremal configurations depend explicitly on the residue class of the number of squares modulo 4.
